blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — The provincial government of La Union has warned against creating, sharing or using artificial intelligence (AI)-generated images depicting individuals wearing police uniforms. It also cautions against the use of insignia, identification cards or other official markings of the Philippine National Police (PNP). Provincial Resolution No. 2463-2026 said the unabated proliferation of misleading AI-generated content depicting law enforcement personnel poses a genuine threat to public trust, public safety and the integrity of the PNP. “It may likewise be exploited to facilitate scams, extortion, harassment and other unlawful schemes against unsuspecting residents of the province,” the resolution said.
